# `aitbc operations ai submit-job`

Submit an AI job with wallet, type, prompt, and payment.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc operations ai submit-job [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet-name` | text | — | yes | Client wallet name |
| `--job-type` | text | — | yes | Type of AI job |
| `--prompt` | text | — | yes | AI prompt |
| `--payment` | decimal | — | yes | Payment amount |
| `--model` | text | — | no | AI model to use |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc operations ai submit-job --wallet-name <wallet_name> --job-type <job_type> --prompt <prompt> --payment <payment>
```
